name: ANSI/IEEE three-position key selector symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for three-position key selector, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The key-operated three-position selector form combines a contact schedule with controlled operator access. Stable positions, return behaviour and key-removal restrictions must be supplied by the chosen operator assembly.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify where the key may be removed without assuming every position permits it.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Key access does not change the contacts' electrical ratings or establish an isolation function.
